description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's '--orphan' branch checkout functionality. It sets up test scenarios, runs Git commands to verify behaviors, and checks outcomes related to orphan branches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies their success.

methods.name: git
methods.description: Calls the Git command-line tool with specified arguments.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that the preceding command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test's internal clock to simulate time passage between commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
